description: Button layout as Chromium's (BLITZ-GAPS, fixed in the fork: buttons with an author display, flex buttons without justify-content): a default button; an author display: flex button without alignment (content at the start, stretched); a switch-like inline-flex track with align-items: center only, its thumb toggled by a click; display: block and inline-block buttons with a height (shrink-to-fit, content centred vertically); a block child in a wide block button (at the start, centred vertically); a grid button; buttons stretched by a flex column and a flex row; a tall button whose label wraps. Geometry of every button and its content; the buttons are a pixel region
